# P28.1 — Entity resolution at scale + the eval loop (Round 6 keystone)

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/P28.1__entity-resolution-at-scale.md` · **ADR:** ADR-099 (cited) ·
**Base:** `devin/round6-7-seed` · **Deferral:** D-R6.1-EVAL (annotated, kept OPEN)

## Summary

Activates the built-but-dormant ER + gold-set + quality-gate machinery on the real spine and
**materializes** the §16.4 `resolution` decision record (which had never held a row — the launch
posture computed it on read, ADR-092). The resolution write path was genuinely missing; this ticket
adds it, append-only and idempotent, governed by a **measured** precision floor and a calibrated
LLM-vs-seed eval loop. Every number is **PROVISIONAL** (LLM-bootstrap; OSM land in flight) and
disclosed via D-R6.1-EVAL — no fabricated green.

## What changed

- **`db/` — new sqitch change `resolution_materialize`** (deploy/revert/verify + plan entry): a
  nullable `input_digest` column on `resolution` + a partial UNIQUE index (mirrors `claim_content_digest`
  / ADR-059) so the materializer can `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`. Additive, back-compatible.
- **`reconcile/materialize.py` + `reconcile materialize --dsn`** — runs the §28 resolver over the spine
  and writes the envelopes as append-only, idempotent `resolution` rows (insert-only; no UPDATE/DELETE;
  re-run +0). Maps `Resolution` → the table (support→confidence, text ids→`uuid[]`, machine-readable
  `evidence_counts`); ensures the FK vocab (strategy/rationale/confidence) like `PgClaimSink`; skips
  predicates the ruleset can't adjudicate (never guesses); keeps contradictions visible (unresolved
  envelopes are written too, §3.1).
- **`resolution/adjudicator.py`** — the LLM adjudicator (`llm:rulebased@v1`) reading the versioned
  `adjudication_rules`; the gold-set bootstrap = maintainer seed + LLM, disagreement → disputed.
- **`resolution/eval_loop.py`** — the measured pass: LLM-vs-seed Cohen's κ gate, P/R/F1 at tier
  boundaries + B-cubed on the frozen holdout, `demote_auto_write_tiers` at the measured floor,
  cluster-shape alerts, and active-learning review routing (model↔LLM disagreements + near-boundary).
  Adds the missing `auto_write_precision_threshold` reader.
- **config:** `auto_write_precision_threshold` 0.97 → **0.98** (`splink_model.toml`); new `kappa_bar`
  = 0.7 (`gold_set_rules.toml`). Both PROVISIONAL (D-R6.1-EVAL).
- **eval report** `docs/build/reports/P28.1_resolution_eval.md` (+ reproducible generator
  `scripts/eval/run_resolution_eval.py`) — the operator's P28.5 evidence.

## Design decisions

- **New sqitch change = the idempotency column**, not a new table: the `resolution` table already
  exists (P02.1); what was missing was the append-only idempotency key. Kept minimal + additive.
- **The "LLM adjudicator" is realized as a deterministic rules-encoded adjudicator** so the committed
  gold set + eval numbers are reproducible in CI; wiring a live model behind the same `Adjudicator`
  interface (and re-measuring κ on drift) is exactly what D-R6.1-EVAL owns. Disclosed in the report.
- **Live-over-hosted materialization is operator-gated** (the migration must deploy to prod first + an
  operator-held read/materialize role must run it — Cloud SQL `postgres` is not a superuser). Proven
  over real PG18+PostGIS via testcontainers instead; the hosted scale eval is deferred (D-R6.1-EVAL)
  with the exact re-run command. No fabricated hosted numbers.
- **Public methodology-page surfacing** belongs to P28.5 (surface refresh, out of scope here); the
  report is committed and ready.
